description: This script configures wireless interfaces, manages hostapd services, updates network configurations, and starts services like dnsmasq and lighttpd for router setup and bridge mode configuration.

methods.name: Restart_Hostapd
methods.description: Restarts the hostapd service for 2.4 GHz interface.

methods.name: Restart_Hostapd_5G
methods.description: Restarts the hostapd service for 5 GHz interface.

methods.name: Hostapd_Restart
methods.description: Restarts the hostapd service for the primary interface.
